source.tools: Capstone 5.0.7 over the file-backed PE sections, Ghidra 12.1.4 decompilation as a lead

contexts.familyIndex: key & 3 for keys below 8: 0 TPS, 1 FPS, 2 WowTPS, 3 WowFPS

pipeline.elapsedSource: first dword of the update argument

queueB.item: first 16-bit word of the command payload

rows.effect: stores 12 payload bytes at +0x1BC, then requests key 0 or 1
slot 0 to payload float 0, then 0x00619F80 with float 1

commands.dragGate: commands 40, 41, 42 return while +0x1BC or +0x1BE is nonzero

follow.predicate: bit 3 of the dword at helper +4
follow.targetYaw: actor heading lane minus pi, wrapped
follow.flagRule: 1 while the predicate holds, else 0, rewritten every tick

unresolved: unit of the elapsed integer in the update argument, so the seconds per dt unit and the blend duration in seconds
look-at point: the object vector from 0x00664100 through the actor vtable slots +0x88, +0x94 and +0x9C
key 0 and key 4 follow logic in 0x007F3BA0 and 0x007F7260, including the radius changes through the setter calls at 0x007F40CE and 0x007F727F
payload and effect of command 0x29, the middle-button drag
collision margin: the query helpers 0x00613880 and 0x006141E0 depend on runtime geometry through 0x00AF94D0
producers of the focal byte +0x1C4, the offset byte +0x1C5 and the invert byte +0x1C6
meaning of the predicates 0x00616F90 and 0x007A3A60 in user terms, and of the pointer-handler gate 0x004D7580 with its vtable +0x0C and +0x30 methods
camera effect of the script natives _lockCameraControl, _unlockCameraControl, _isCameraControlEnabled and _forceCameraTPSMode, resolved only to registration stubs
keyboard and pad rotation: argument values of RaptureCommands.MoveCamera and the key 0 rates
whether the 0x007A4610 predicate holds during ordinary walking
consumers of command 0x2E, 0x30 and 0x2F payload floats beyond the stores listed
